title: Member Share of a Stand-Alone Contact-Lens Fitting — Vision Plans Adjudication Rule
content:
**Vision Plans claims rule: the stand-alone contact-lens fitting**

**What it is.** A stand-alone fitting is the contact-lens fitting line of a claim of the enrollment that carries neither a routine eye exam line nor a contact-lens line.

**Which fitting is looked at.** The claim found first in this order:

| Order | Fitting line looked for | Where |
|---|---|---|
| 1 | Latest received specialty fitting line with no remark yet | Participating independent practice |
| 2 | Same | Participating retail-chain location |
| 3 | Latest received standard fitting line with no remark yet | Participating independent practice |
| 4 | Same | Participating retail-chain location |
| 5 | Latest received specialty fitting line standing denied as not eligible | Any location |
| 6 | Latest received standard fitting line standing denied as not eligible | Any location |

When that claim also carries a routine eye exam line or a contact-lens line, its fitting belongs to the exam visit or the contact-lens order, and this rule settles nothing for it: a member share of 0.00 under this rule. The fitting's date of service, received date, network channel, provider agreement, billed charge and kind are read from its line.

**Coverage.** The fitting is settled under the fitting benefit only when the enrollment is active or terminated, and the date of service is on or after its coverage effective date and on or before its termination date when it has one. Otherwise its lines are denied as not eligible and the member pays the whole billed charge.

**Plan without a contact-lens benefit.** A stand-alone fitting, being part of the contacts benefit, is denied as not covered. At a participating location it is bought at the plan's materials discount percent off its charge; out of network nothing is reimbursed and the member pays the whole receipt.

**Out of network, plan with a contact-lens benefit.** The fitting is reimbursed the lesser of its receipt and the plan's out-of-network exam amount, and the member pays the rest of the receipt. A fitting is not limited by frequency separately.

**Under the fitting benefit.**
- A stand-alone specialty fitting receives the plan's specialty fitting allowance as its fitting allowance. The member pays the part of the billed charge above the fitting allowances, never below 0.00.
- A stand-alone standard fitting costs the member that same part, but at most the plan's standard fitting maximum.

**Assembly.** Every allowance that applies to a stand-alone fitting is added into one combined fitting allowance before the fitting's member share is taken as the sentences for its kind and location state. The member share is rounded half up to the cent once, at the end.

**Worked figures (hypothetical).** On a plan with a specialty fitting allowance of 60.00 and a standard maximum of 60.00, at a participating location:
- A specialty fitting billed 97.45 leaves the member 37.45.
- A standard fitting billed 104.15 leaves the member 44.15, which is within the 60.00 maximum.

Out of network, on a plan whose out-of-network exam amount is 50.00, a fitting receipt of 77.60 leaves the member 27.60.
